comment: The table of std.rt for the calls of C that its rows hold. One row gives the copy of
rt.buffer_append back to memcpy, whose ranges must not overlap (ISO C11 7.24.2.1), where a
module can give the bytes of the buffer itself. A std module is not part of the compiler
binary, so the md5 guard reads the copy of the module in the standard root of the debug
preset, and the build copies it there itself. The stage runs run/stdlib/179, which links a
memcpy that stops the run for overlapping ranges. The table runs in the VM with the default

stages.name: the overlap test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --cc /usr/bin/clang --target x86_64-linux-gnu run/stdlib/179

mutations.what: buffer_append copies with memcpy, which takes no overlapping ranges
